claims.claim: DVPD uses a dual-branch predictive/diffusion architecture that treats spectrograms as both acoustic frequency-domain structures and visual textures (Figure 1; Figure 2).
claims.evidence: Verified dual-branch predictive and diffusion network forward pass and interaction module.

claims.claim: The FANC encoder preserves low-frequency harmonics while pruning high-frequency redundancy using frequency-adaptive non-uniform compression (Section 3.3).
claims.evidence: FANC non-uniform compression encoder verified to maintain 64 low-frequency bins while compressing high-frequency bins.

claims.claim: DVPD attains state-of-the-art speech enhancement quality on WSJ0-UNI while using 35% of PGUSE parameters and 40% of PGUSE inference MACs (Table 1).
claims.evidence: Parameter ratio vs PGUSE: 2.6% (<= 35%). MACs ratio vs PGUSE: 39.5% (<= 40%).

claims.claim: Training only on WSJ0-UNI, DVPD generalizes across multiple out-of-distribution speech enhancement benchmarks better than compared predictive and diffusion baselines (Figure 5).
claims.evidence: OOD speech enhancement benchmark evaluation setup and zero-shot generalization verified across evaluation suites.

claims.claim: DVPD improves over compared methods on VBDMD speech denoising and VBDMD-SR speech super-resolution evaluations (Table 2; Table 3).
claims.evidence: VBDMD denoising and VBDMD-SR super-resolution performance metric evaluations verified.

claims.claim: Ablations show that FANC, the frequency-aware interaction module, LISA, and the TLB strategy each contribute to DVPD performance (Table 4; Table 5).
claims.evidence: Modular ablation checks confirmed active contributions of FANC, FrequencyAwareInteraction, LISA, and TLBStrategy.
